nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Vector control strategies_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What health risks are associated with mosquito bites that DEET helps to prevent?
nodes.answer: DEET helps to protect against mosquito-borne illnesses such as malaria, zika virus, Lyme disease, spotted fever, and the Nile virus.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Vector control strategies_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the primary use of N,N-Diethyl-m-toluamide (DEET)?
nodes.answer: DEET is primarily used in personal care products as a preventive measure against mosquito-borne diseases.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Vector control strategies_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are the main uses of DEET as mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: DEET is primarily used in products such as lotions, sprays, and towelettes as an insect repellent.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Vector control strategies_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How does DEET function to deter insects?
nodes.answer: DEET works by impeding the olfactory perception of hematophagous insects towards the human scent.
